Subject: Post-demo burn profile & PO/Legal lead time (confirm budget band)

Hi Tina —

Great to meet you and Ravi on the call today. Quick recap and a couple of clarifying asks so we can align the pilot pricing and procurement path: 

- Usage signal: you mentioned production traffic could ramp from ~30M tokens/mo up to ~80M tokens/mo over 3–6 months. Please flag if that range should shift.
- Target unit economics: you said finance is aiming for something around $40 / 1M tokens as a target for sustained usage (happy to revisit).
- Immediate ask: confirm the monthly spend band you expect the pilot to sit in (e.g., $1k–$3k / month based on the token range above) — we need this to size reserved capacity and pricing tiers.
- Procurement notes we recorded: internal PO threshold and legal review requirement (we'll need exact thresholds and lead time).

Next steps I propose:
1) You confirm the expected steady-state monthly token band (pick low/mid/high).
2) Connor will draft a short mutual action plan and send a pilot SOW + pricing options (metered vs reserved).
3) If PO is required, please confirm finance's PO minimum and legal review lead time so we can surface any internal discount/commitment options.

Attached: pilot-scope.xlsx (high level), SOW-draft.docx (template).

If it helps, we can run a short cost simulation for the three consumption scenarios and show the effective $/1M tokens for each (including batching/caching opportunities). Happy to do that after you confirm the band.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference

Hi Stephanie —

Thanks for the recap — that captures the discussion well. Quick answers from our side:

- Expected monthly consumption for the pilot: low ~30M tokens / month, mid ~50M, high ~80M. The team expects to sit at mid for the first month and may ramp to high if latency/quality checks pass.
- Our finance target: roughly $35–$45 / 1M tokens; $40 is a solid median.
- Procurement: PO is required for anything > $5,000 / month and triggers a legal review. For pilot-level spend (<= $5k/mo) we can usually process with our standard MSA (no procurement PO) and a PO is optional.

We'll confirm the internal org owner who signs the PO and the finance contact early next week. For now, assume pilot will be in the $1.2k–$3.2k / month band (30–80M tokens at ~$40 / 1M).

Appreciate Connor and Karthik looping in the pricing/ops notes.

Best,
Tina Zhao
Head of Product, OrchardAI

Tina / Stephanie — forwarding our internal notes plus a suggested mutual action plan. Short overview here — see attached for the SOW draft and pilot scope.

Pilot options (summary):
- Metered (no commit): standard hosted rates, $/1M tokens as quoted; good for fast start, easier procurement.
- 1‑month reserved pilot: modest commit (~$2k–$3k) gives an effective reduction in $/1M tokens due to reserved capacity.
- 3‑month trial commit: three-month commit at a defined monthly band — better unit economics and supports predictable capacity for latency-sensitive routes.

Procurement checkpoints:
- If OrchardAI expects spend to exceed $5k/mo we should plan for a PO + legal review. Connor: please provide sample PO language and expected invoice cadence.
- If PO < $5k/mo, we can execute under our standard MSA (digital signature) and bill monthly.

Action items:
- Tina: confirm finance owner and PO minimum approver (ETA Tue 11/11).
- Karthik: will create a quick cost-simulation table showing effective $/1M tokens at 30/50/80M tokens with and without caching/batching.
- Stephanie: will schedule a 30-minute pilot planning call for Wed 11/12.

Attachments referenced: pilot-scope.xlsx, SOW-draft.docx

Connor O'Brien
Solutions Ops, Redwood Inference
